title: FRIDAY ARMS + CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. OPEN THE CHEST, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN PUSH AND BRACE. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE CHEST, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN PUSH AND BRACE. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE DONE. CHEST OPEN. CORE HONEST. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND CHEST OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE CHEST AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: FIFTH STAIR. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. FULL LOCKOUT. THIS IS YOUR ARM WORK. DO NOT DROP THE STEP.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. FIFTH STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. FULL LOCKOUT. THIS IS YOUR ARM WORK. DO NOT SAG LIKE A BLOODY HAMMOCK.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. RETURN WITH CONTROL. CORE STAYS QUIET AND BRACED. NO FLOPPING.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW AND CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR CORE CONTROL. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BEACHED BLOODY FISH.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BELLY QUIET.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN SHORT AND CLEAN. STEADY PACE. ARMS BRACE. CORE WORKS. NO FLOPPY HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN. STEADY PACE. ARMS AND CORE TOGETHER. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SEAL ON A ROCK.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM UNDER THE SHOULDER. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. BUILD TOWARD LONGER LATER.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. HIPS UP. SHORT HOLDS. WE BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
